info.title: INVENTRAK Inventory Management API
info.description: Backend API for the INVENTRAK inventory management system. Both the SQLite (Express) backend and the npm-free fallback expose this identical contract. Live docs: GET /api/docs

get.summary: QR product lookup: resolve a scanned tag payload / SKU / bare id to a product (staff or admin)
get.description: The single round-trip behind QR product identification. Accepts the tag payload (INVENTRAK:PROD:<id>), a SKU (PRD-000042 or a custom code), or a bare numeric id (legacy barcode fallback). Returns the product, its QR tag data, a live per-location stock snapshot and open FIFO lots. The QR authorizes NOTHING — normal authentication, product status, location, quantity and approval rules all still apply after the scan.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Scanned QR content: tag payload, SKU or bare product id. URL-encoded when it contains colons.

200.description: Product identified with live stock and lots

phone.description: Valid PH mobile number (09171234567, +639171234567 or 639171234567). Required — used for SMS verification and order updates under the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173).

error.description: Human-readable explanation: staff accounts are mobile-only

portal.description: Portal flag identifying which app is signing in. portal=admin (web admin): mobile-only roles (Inventory Staff) are refused with 403 portal_mobile_only. portal=staff (dedicated staff app): only Inventory Staff is admitted — admins/owners are refused with 403 staff_app_exclusive. Omitted by the customer app.

image.description: Product photo: '/images/<file>' served by the backend, or a full URL

sku.description: Custom SKU (3-32 chars: A-Z, 0-9, dashes). Omit to get the deterministic system SKU (PRD-<padded id>). Cannot be cleared once set — reprint the tag instead.

FEFO expiry date (ISO). null = non-perishable lot, consumed in pure FIFO order.

demo_accounts_disabled.description: true = seeded demo logins (admin/customer/staff/owner/superadmin) are refused with the generic error. OWASP: no default accounts in production.

low_stock_multiplier.description: Low-stock badge widening factor: low_stock when qty ≤ criticalLevel × factor.

session_token_hours.description: Session token lifetime in hours (applies to tokens issued after the change).
